# Welcome to the Platform Team

Your first two weeks, in one place

## Week one

- Set up your laptop with the **bootstrap script**
- Pair with your onboarding buddy on a real ticket
- Read the [architecture overview](https://example.com/architecture) before Thursday
- Ship one small change to production by Friday

*Ask in #platform-help — nobody expects you to know this yet.*

## What we own

- Build and deploy pipeline
- Service templates
- Internal developer portal

---

## What we don't

- Product feature work
- Customer data pipelines
- On-call for product services
## Key numbers 14 minutes median deploy time 99.95% pipeline availability last quarter 1. Keep deploys under 15 minutes 2. Keep flaky tests under 1%
